decisions.reason: Certification for HVAC is a sunk investment that management wants to justify, and one year on the market is too early to judge, even though the product is only mentioned rather than featured.
The firm publicly claims high quality and a major market share in water cooling, so this product is central to its identity and dropping it would contradict its own claims.
It has its own web page, a visible commitment, and it fits the firm's marine cooling direction alongside the box cooler.
Only a brief mention signals low commitment, but the cost of keeping a small oil cooler line is low and weak results can still be blamed on the short time on the market.
The dedicated page and its link to the firm's core tube and air cooler technology create strong commitment, so management would persist with it.
Enhanced tubes are a core technology with development costs already invested and a featured web presence, which makes the firm stick with them.
